meta.title: John Doe | Mobile App Developer
meta.description: Senior iOS & Android developer crafting beautiful, performant mobile experiences. 8+ years of experience, 25+ published apps, 10M+ downloads.

hero.name: John Doe
hero.tagline: I build pixel-perfect, performant mobile apps that users love.

about.bio: I'm a passionate mobile developer based in San Francisco, specializing in building exceptional iOS and Android applications.
about.bioExtended:
With over 8 years of experience in mobile development, I've had the privilege of working with startups, digital agencies, and large corporations. I focus on creating intuitive, accessible, and performant mobile experiences that delight users and drive business results.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or hiking in the Bay Area.

experience.description: Leading mobile development for flagship consumer apps with millions of daily active users.
achievements: Led team of 5 engineers in rebuilding core app in SwiftUI
Reduced app launch time by 60% through performance optimization
Implemented CI/CD pipeline reducing release time from days to hours
Mentored junior developers and conducted technical interviews

experience.description: Built mobile team from ground up and delivered cross-platform fintech application.
achievements: Grew mobile team from 1 to 8 engineers
Launched iOS and Android apps simultaneously
Achieved 4.9 star rating on both app stores
Processed over $50M in transactions through mobile

experience.description: Developed iOS applications for various clients across different industries.
achievements: Delivered 15+ client projects on time and budget
Specialized in healthcare and fitness apps
